title: Distinct-node Lagrange reconstruction
statement: Let $K$ be a field [def-weil-field], let $D\geq0$ be an integer, and let $c_0,\ldots,c_D\in K$ be pairwise distinct. Define $L_j(T)=\prod_{0\leq k\leq D,\ k\ne j}(T-c_k)/(c_j-c_k)\in K[T]$ [def-weil-polynomial-ring]. For every $q\in K[T]$ of degree at most $D$, one has the polynomial identity $q(T)=\sum_{j=0}^D q(c_j)L_j(T)$.
